arStrings.szText: Your {c_important}Arrow Storms{/c} last {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds shorter, deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased damage, and, when created, have a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} chance  to create an additional {c_important}Arrow Storm{/c} on a nearby target.
